name: M5Stack
candidate_notes: Official Discord of M5Stack, maker of the ESP32-based Cardputer/Core/Stamp hardware widely used in ESP32 hacking (Marauder, Bruce, Ghost ESP, Evil Crow firmwares). Verified live via invite API, ~4,874 members, inviter account is the official m5stack user.

name: CardPuter
candidate_notes: Community server dedicated to the M5Stack Cardputer hacking-firmware scene, linked from the cardputer.wiki FAQ page. Verified live via invite API, guild name "CardPuter", ~2,166 members.

name: GBAtemp
candidate_notes: GBAtemp's official Discord, announced by GBAtemp itself (retro/console hacking, hardware modding community adjacent to Flipper/ModRetro/OSCR interests). Verified live via invite API, ~6,435 members.

name: Lockpicking101.com
candidate_notes: Official companion Discord for the long-running Lockpicking101.com forum, announced by forum staff (Squelchtone) in an official sticky thread. Verified live via invite API, guild "Lockpicking101.com", ~876 members.

name: Software Defined Radio
candidate_notes: Community SDR/HackRF-focused Discord listed on rtl-sdr.com's forum as the HackRF Discord (covers HackRF/PortaPack firmwares and general SDR). Verified live via invite API, guild name "Software Defined Radio", 446 members — smaller/niche but genuine and on-topic.

name: OSINT-FR
candidate_notes: Large (30k+ member) French-founded but internationally active OSINT community server; invite verified live on Discord's own invite page (server name confirmed as 'OSINT-FR'). Could not reach osint-fr.net directly to cross-check from the org's own site (DNS did not resolve), so treat as 'listed' rather than 'official'.
